object: a wind-up animal band with a bear drummer and bunny cymbals
morph: an overeager drum charge flies past, skids back, and the gentle second try places the strokes of 年
creativeAngle: 過猶不及：第一次太用力，第二次輕輕就成功。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a warm ivory background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 年 as the only text on screen, drawn in festive lacquer red solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a tin wind-up bear drummer cranks his key until his key spins like a propeller and he rockets across the frame, shooting past the center where the first 年 is spoken and only the 生-like top strokes of 年 fall in with a clang. 1.7-3.4s: he skids back on his rubber feet with sparks of confetti, bumping a wind-up bunny cymbalist whose cymbals crash; the second 年 spoken as the long middle stroke drops down and the bottom bar tucks under it. 3.4-5s: the bear takes a gentle second try, tapping the drum once softly; 過年 is spoken as the drum pops open and a cloud of red paper pom-poms and a tiny paper lantern puffs up (animated shapes, no text). 5-8s: hold; the bear and bunny wobble in a tiny wind-up dance beside the glyph. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "年、年、過年" (ㄋㄧㄢˊ、ㄋㄧㄢˊ、ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄋㄧㄢˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 年 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
